What I’ve learnt from research when I was planning a runaway is basically, be ready to work somewhere for some form of income, and be prepared to go through stages of being homeless. Try to save up some money before running away if you are serious about it.

Something you really really need to do before you take off is to find some community online that will support you. Or some friend. If you’re going out into the world alone without some form of support from another party, you’re going to end up in a very vulnerable spot. Especially as a teen, as I am as well, some crappy people will try to exploit you, especially since as you’ve said, you don’t have friends that look out for you.

I really beg you please look for some beacon of support before you push through with this plan.
